tubuild create reported one declaration CONFLICT: the legacy Behavior source declared _ZN10dBgActor_c19UpdateClsnPosAndRotEv returning int and the legacy InitResources source returning void. Resolved by deleting both mangled externs and calling the real member dBgActor_c::UpdateClsnPosAndRot(), which include/dBgActor_c.h already declares as returning void. Re-verified 7/7 MATCH after the change, so the int spelling was never load-bearing.

The class-body destructor makes this the key-function TU, so the compile emits the class vtable and the inherited vague-linkage RTTI chain. Every emitted record resolves to a cartridge address and is licensed below as deadstrip-data against that address; no config/arm9/overlays/*/symbols.txt row was added, moved or renamed to make one resolve. This is the promotion that PR #2756's rename to the ROM RTTI name unblocked: under the earlier coined spelling _ZTI6ShipUp and _ZTS6ShipUp had no ROM home at all, and tubuild refused to license them.

func_ov016_021126a8 keeps its address-derived name and its (char *) signature. Nothing is coined, nothing is renamed, so include/decl_common.h's declaration of it stays and matches this TU's own declaration exactly.
The two adjacent factories and the g_profile_KI_FUNE / g_profile_KI_FUNE_UP descriptors are outside this TU; see boundary_evidence. They keep their own legacy sources and delinks entries.
